status: preparation layer only; a local file hash is not a pre-registration

time.signal_time: last instant of calendar month t (UTC)
time.known_rule: a fundamentals version is known for signal month t when available_at and ingested_at are strictly before the first instant of month t+1 (UTC)
time.trade_time: first tradable price after signal_time (next month); the monthly layer approximates it by the month t+1 return and therefore cannot respect 'execute at the next tradable time' to the day (see gap_table)
time.label_interval: calendar month t+1 (diagnostics only; labels never enter a signal, a transform or a parameter)

universe.rule: listed at signal_time (as-of membership including later-delisted names)

trial_ledger: every variant evaluated is recorded in qa/a5/claude/results/p04 (counts in the results file)
